title: How to Cancel Cox Internet Now That Cox Is Becoming Spectrum (2026)
description: Cancelling Cox internet after Charter closed its Cox purchase on August 20, 2026: what changed, the early termination fees CableTV.com reports, and how to return equipment. Checked November 27, 2026.
lead: What changed after Charter bought Cox, the cancellation fees reported by CableTV.com, and what to check before you leave.
short_answer: Charter closed its $34.5 billion purchase of Cox on August 20, 2026, and Cox markets are moving to the Spectrum brand. CableTV.com reports Cox early termination fees of $120 on one-year and $240 on two-year contracts, lowered by $10 for each month remaining. Check your own agreement and ask Cox or Spectrum for the exact amount before you cancel.

sections.h2: What changed: Cox is becoming Spectrum
sections.body_html: AZFamily and Light Reading reported that Charter closed its $34.5 billion merger with Cox on August 20, 2026. Reports say Spectrum pricing and packaging were to reach former Cox markets by mid-September, AZFamily reported bills will show the Spectrum name, and the parent company takes the Cox Communications name within a year. Neither report tells customers to take any action, and neither says existing Cox prices change. Because the brand and systems are in transition, confirm with the company which entity and plan your account is on before you cancel. See our Cox bill went up and lower your Cox bill guides.

Ask whether you can move to a current Spectrum plan at a lower price instead of leaving. If you only need a break, CableTV.com reports Cox offered a pause of 1 to 9 months at a reduced $9.99 monthly fee for each paused service. That is a reported figure from a third party, so confirm it before relying on it.

Use the phone number on your latest bill or in your account, or visit a local store, since Cox and Spectrum contact routes are changing and we only list routes the provider itself publishes. CableTV.com reports you can also cancel at a local Cox store. Note that CableTV.com's article was first published in 2021, so its fee and pause figures may not reflect Spectrum terms after the transition.

  1. Ask for your final bill amount and the disconnect date, and whether any fee applies.
  2. Ask for the early termination fee in writing if you are in a term agreement.
  3. Ask where to return equipment and what the deadline is.
  4. Write down the agent's name, date and confirmation details.

faq: How do I cancel Cox internet?
Use the phone number on your latest bill or account, or visit a local store. CableTV.com also reports you can cancel at a local Cox store.
Is Cox the same as Spectrum now?
Charter closed its purchase of Cox on August 20, 2026, and Cox markets are moving to the Spectrum brand. Check your bill for which company name and plan apply to your account.
Is there a Cox early termination fee?
CableTV.com reports $120 on one-year and $240 on two-year contracts, reduced by $10 for each month remaining. Check your own agreement.
